title: Staffing route catalog
description: Top-level catalog of dispatch routes. Route identity is the tuple (model, effort, harness, channel). This schema defines shape only; it encodes no selection, ranking, probability, or pricing decisions. Dispatch templates are data and are never executed by validation.

route_id.description: Stable string identifier for this route.

model.description: Model identifier; part of the route identity tuple.

effort.description: Model effort dial; part of the route identity tuple. Null only where the harness has no effort dial.

harness.description: Harness identifier; part of the route identity tuple.

channel.description: Channel identifier; part of the route identity tuple. Must match a channel_id in the channel catalog.

dispatch_template.description: Dispatch template as data. Never executed by validation.
